sentiment.rationale: Full-year organic revenue guidance was reaffirmed at 5%-6%, but comparable currency-neutral EPS guidance was raised to approximately 8% growth from a prior expectation (implied by the update). Management expressed confidence in delivering on updated guidance despite acknowledging currency headwinds and dynamic conditions. The guidance raise is organic, not attributed to one-time items, supporting a mildly positive score.

summary.revenue: Net revenues grew 1% to $12.5 billion; organic revenues (non-GAAP) grew 5%.
summary.eps: Comparable EPS (non-GAAP) grew 4% to $0.87; GAAP EPS grew 58% to $0.88.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2025 organic revenue growth expected at 5%-6%; comparable currency-neutral EPS growth of approximately 8%; comparable EPS growth of approximately 3% versus $2.88 in 2024, including a 5% currency headwind.
summary.margin: Comparable gross margin increased approximately 80 basis points; comparable operating margin increased approximately 190 basis points to 34.7%.
key_risks: Currency headwinds: 1%-2% headwind to full-year comparable net revenues and 5% headwind to comparable EPS.
Global unit case volume declined 1% in Q2, impacted by adverse weather, difficult prior year comparisons, and consumer pressure in select markets.
Capacity constraints limiting Fairlife volume growth until New York facility comes online in early 2026.
Dynamic external environment with rapid turns and uncertainty, including geopolitical conflicts and weather events.
Higher effective tax rate (approximately 2-point increase) impacting EPS.
key_opportunities: Seventeenth consecutive quarter of value share gains in total NARTD beverages.
Productivity initiatives driving margin expansion, with faster realization than expected.
Innovation pipeline including Sprite plus Tea, new Coca-Cola cane sugar variant, and Fairlife capacity expansion in 2026.
Marketing transformation and digital tools (AI-based pack price optimization) scaling across markets.
Strong brand performance: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Diet Coke, Fanta, Fairlife, BodyArmor, Powerade each grew volume.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management stated 'we are confident we can navigate varying local market dynamics during the remainder of 2025 to deliver on our updated guidance' and 'we have great confidence we will deliver on our updated 2025 guidance and create enduring value for our stakeholders.'
